title.zh: 对第 7100 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 7100 and Converting the Santiago High School in Barangay Santiago, Municipality of General Trias, Province of Cavite, Into An Annex of the Gov. Luis Ferrer Memorial High School, to Be Known as the Santiago Annex and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 7100 and Converting the Santiago High School in Barangay Santiago, Municipality of General Trias, Province of Cavite, Into An Annex of the Gov. Luis Ferrer Memorial High School, to Be Known as the Santiago Annex and Appropriating Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7795_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Santiago High School in Barangay Santiago, Municipality of General Trias, Province of Cavite, shall, by virtue of this Act, be converted into an annex of the Gov. Luis Ferrer Memorial High School, to be known as the Santiago Annex.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act hereby amends Republic Act No. 7100.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon approval.
